annotations.title: Add an attached or linked file to the Playground canvas

description: Add one image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, ≤8 MB), video (MP4, ≤16 MB) or audio file (MP3 or WAV, ≤12 MB) to the canvas as a file node that can feed image and video generation. Pass exactly one source: file for a file the user attached in this chat (Berrys downloads it itself; no upload step), or url for a public HTTPS link. Bytes are checked and copied into project storage. Private, local and internal addresses are refused, and every redirect is rechecked. Free; revision checked and idempotent. Returns imported asset node details, revision and Playground URL.

expectedRevision.description: Current canvas revision from canvas_read; on revision_conflict, read again and rebuild the change.

file.description: A file the user attached in chat, as provided by the host. Omit when passing url.

download_url.description: Host-provided attachment download URL; Berrys downloads the file server-side.

file_id.description: Host-provided identifier for the attached file.

file_name.description: Original name of the attached file, including extension.

mime_type.description: Content type supplied by the attachment host.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for this request; reuse only when retrying the identical request after a lost response. Use a new key after quoting or changing inputs.

kind.description: Media type to create or import, selected from the supported values.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

url.description: Public media URL to import as a canvas asset; for chat attachments use file instead. A public HTTPS link to the media. Omit when passing file.

name: playground_asset_import
title: Add an attached or linked file to the Playground canvas
